name: agent-harness-design
description: Design and review agent execution layers that preserve authorized capability while enforcing narrow authority and effect boundaries.

interface.shortDescription: Preserve agent capability at trusted effect boundaries
interface.longDescription: Adds a provider-neutral Skill for designing, auditing, debugging, and evaluating agent harnesses. It preserves the selected model's authorized capability envelope, distinguishes hard trust boundaries from defaults and conditional patterns, and measures the utility cost of controls.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use $agent-harness-design to preserve authorized capability while enforcing authority and effects at narrow trusted boundaries.
